title: metrics-agent.service isn't running, but systemd doesn't call it failed
description_md:
`metrics-agent` is supposed to be running on every host, but `systemctl is-active metrics-agent` reports `inactive` -- not `failed`, not `masked`, just quietly not running -- and `systemctl start metrics-agent` returns success without anything actually starting. The provisioning step that's supposed to flip this host into the rollout was apparently skipped. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`), figure out why systemd treats this as a non-event instead of an error, and get the agent genuinely running.

You're done when `systemctl is-active metrics-agent` reports `active`.
